scope: Actual We’re Doomed play, nine drain outcomes at 1/2/5 with no droid/C-3PO/R2-D2, four fixture arrival/departure interventions after a paid unit, two It Could Be Worse/It’s Worse drain interactions and two battle damage/payment/increase outcomes. Drain bases use an explicit fixture-only ForceDrainModifier, not a claimed implemented card source. Droid movement is a fixture intervention, not a played movement card. GEMP production code unchanged.
references: AR printed p155 We’re Doomed: not a drain response; halving precedes other automatic reductions/modifiers
AR printed p41: loss reduction is not a modifier to the drain amount
Card1_120.java: opponent Control, Life Force <15, turn duration and dynamic targetable droid condition
Force.getForceToLose and LoseForceEffect.getForceLossRemaining: total halving then paid credit; drain bonuses before loss calculation
Forfeit.getTotalBattleDamage and BattleState.getBattleDamageRemaining: half base damage before later modifiers, retain payment credit
differences: GEMP automatically settles an empty final-unit response before returning from LSChooseCard. In depart-3 the one-unit rounded loss is already complete when the harness moves C-3PO; observed pending=0/lost=1. The native comparison likewise completes the loss before that intervention. Native-only test separately changes rounding inside its serialized final-unit response and reopens the remaining obligation. This is not an executed same-window GEMP comparison; no full timing or legal-choice parity is claimed.
limits: Current explicit C-3PO 1_5 and R2-D2 2_14 identities only; other personas, permanent R2 astromechs, targetability/inactivity/capture and complete droid text are pending. Supplemental droid metadata cannot be deployed or admitted. Ledger supports current nonnegative integer drain/effect/battle losses and existing reduction/increase handlers, not every fractional modifier/limit/prevention/replacement. Full card/deck admission and native match service/UI remain unfinished.
